# peakhour_rp_waf_rule_group (Resource)

Manages the enabled state of a WAF rule group (file) within a ruleset for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_waf_rule_group" "example" {
  domain    = "example.com"
  ruleset   = "owaspv33"
  file_name = "REQUEST-920-PROTOCOL-ENFORCEMENT.conf"
  enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule group is enabled.
- `file_name` (String) Rule group file name.
- `ruleset` (String) Ruleset name (e.g. owaspv33).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Rule group description (computed).
- `id` (String) Rule group identifier (domain/ruleset/<ruleset>/rulegroup/<file_name>).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_waf_rule_group.example example.com/ruleset/owaspv33/rulegroup/REQUEST-920-PROTOCOL-ENFORCEMENT.conf
```
